nodes.text: Epic sci-fi concept art, extreme low-angle wide shot of a colossal spacecraft hovering above a sandstorm-ravaged desert. The open hangar glows furnace-orange through dense blowing dust and volumetric light shafts. A long boarding ramp descends to the dunes; a lone human climbs it, wind-whipped sand swirling around their ankles, tiny against the massive hull. Low amber sun behind the craft casts a hard silhouette and long god-rays across ochre and rust dunes. Distant convoy lights glimmer on the horizon. Monumental scale, cinematic digital illustration, ultra-detailed metal plating and dust particles, desert palette of ochre, rust, and ember orange, dramatic rim light, sharp focus, no text, no watermark.
